title: Chapter 333 Losing Everything
content:
Chapter 333 Losing Everything

Looking at the once glorious Dome Palace, now only these few people are left, Lang Hai felt a little distressed.

Lu Daosheng nodded slightly.

"Chen Yu, you're optimistic."

Lu Daosheng specifically reminded Chen Yu.

The next moment, under the astonishing gaze of everyone, Lu Daosheng slowly took off.

A supreme power surged out of Lu Daosheng's body, and in an instant it covered the entire dome sky.

Immediately afterwards, a scene that made people stare at the eye.

I saw countless remnants of souls slowly emerge from the void and then began to gather towards Lu Daosheng's hands.

And those residual souls are the souls of the dead people in the Dome Heavenly Palace.

Seeing this scene, Langhai was still a little confused.

The people from the Void Palace who arrived were sucking in cold air.

Lord, will he resurrect all the dead? !

Can anyone really do such a huge and amazing move?

It’s not that they don’t believe in Lu Daosheng, but it’s too incredible.

They didn't know that for Lu Daosheng, these were just waves.

He did this just to disgust Chen Yu.

As time goes by, the remnants of souls become vibrant under Lu Daosheng's hands.

I don't know how long it took.

Countless soul bodies stood in the void of the dome Heavenly Palace, bowing deeply to Lu Daosheng.

"Let me wait, thank you for helping me!"

They were grateful.

Although there is no physical body, it is not difficult for them to restore the physical body.

In this world, there is really a way to revive the dead.

On the other side, the waves are already numb.

The adult I followed seemed a bit too awesome.

Chen Yu next to Lu Daosheng looked unbelievable, "How is this possible?"

Hearing the movement, the people in the Dome Heavenly Palace looked at Chen Yu and were shocked.

"Chen Yu!"

Langhai exclaimed.

I was about to report to Lu Daosheng, but I didn't expect that Chen Yu had been sanctioned by Lu Daosheng.

The people in the Dome Heavenly Palace looked at Chen Yu angrily, wishing to peel Chen Yu's cramps and skin.

Facing these gazes, Chen Yu turned a blind eye.

Some people are alive, but they are actually dead.

That's what Chen Yu is like.

Now he is facing the dual torture of both physical and mental.

And at this time, deep in the dome heavenly palace.

A hearty laughter came.

The next moment, a figure broke through the space and appeared directly in front of Lu Daosheng.

"Thank you for helping me for helping me. From now on, I will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the one who will be the

The person who came was the Dome Sky Ancestor who was killed by Chen Yu.

When Langcangshan used the resources given by Lu Daosheng, he was about to break the shackles. With the help of the Heavenly Dao, it was a foregone conclusion to go to the next level.

But at that time, Chen Yu used the power of nothingness to forcibly erase the way of heaven.

Together, there is Langcang Mountain, which is about to break through.

At this time, Langcangshan glanced at Chen Yu beside Lu Daosheng and frowned.

But Lu Daosheng didn't say anything, and he had to suppress the anger in his heart.

Afterwards, Lu Daosheng used the method of transcending the heavens again, and actually condensed the broken heavenly way again.

In an instant, the originally chaotic starry sky restored order again.

"Thank you for your help!"

The way of heaven is the embodiment of a local order. In fact, the way of heaven will appear again after a long time.

But there is no longer the consciousness I used to be.

But Lu Daosheng's help made him reborn.

"You damn thing, even I dare to take action. Do you dare to accept this cause and effect?!"

The way of heaven wiped out the steadfastness of the past and cursed Chen Yu.

Chen Yu was simply a fool in front of him, 25 years old.

Because erasing the way of heaven is a taboo among the taboos.

Once this matter came to the ears of the Order Hall, Chen Yu would still be without a burial place.

However, before the Order Palace was discovered, Lu Daosheng came first.

Faced with the insult of the Heavenly Dao, Chen Yu just lowered his head, and his distorted face was already beyond recognition.

"Ha, don't worry, you Chen clan."

Lu Daosheng chuckled and then came directly to the Chen clan with everyone.

At this moment, the Chen clan had already entered the highest alert, as if facing a great enemy.

They obviously knew the movements of the Palace of Void and Chen Yu’s experience.

After all, the big forces that can stand on the other side of the starry sky must be very informative.

But now, they are about to disappear into the long river of history on the other side of the starry sky.

Just because they provoke existences that should not be provoked.

"Everyone, Chen Yu has been kicked out by my Chen clan and his identity as Chen clan has been cancelled. What he does has nothing to do with my Chen clan!"

A voice from the Chen clan made everyone speechless.

Chen Yu also had a ferocious face.

"Old guy, I'm not doing all this for you, but for the entire Chen clan!"

Chen Yu almost roared.

He devoted almost everything to the Chen clan.

Of course, he was actually just using the Chen clan to realize his desires.

The Chen clan needs him, and he also needs the Chen clan.

Just help each other.

But now, with one side losing, the other side will be affected.

So, the scene of dog biting a dog appeared.

"Chen Yu, you tried to get involved in the Palace of Void and offended all the greats of the Palace of Void and killed the former young palace master of the Palace of Void and killed the Heavenly Dao and killed the ancestor of the Palace of Void and the various evil deeds are no longer worthy of me. People of the clan.”

"After many decisions from the Chen clan, you, Chen Yu, will officially remove yourself from the Chen clan!"

"Everyone, Chen Yu will bear all the cause and effect alone. Please do not hurt the innocent."

The powerful words kept coming from the Chen clan.

Everyone present laughed in their hearts.

OK, don't hurt innocent people.

Why didn't you say that when you ate?

"Chen Yu, your family is quite interesting."

Lu Daosheng turned his head to look at Chen Yu, who was already a little crazy, and said with a playful smile.

It is really a miracle that Chen Yu can still remain sober today.

Without further ado, Lu Daosheng directly issued an order to destroy the clan.

He never thought of letting the Chen clan go from the beginning.

What he had to do was to destroy everything Chen Yu had, including what he did.

"Ah! No, let's surrender, surrender!!"

"Kill, no one is left!"

Lu Daosheng spoke coldly.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng didn't even need to do it himself.

Just stood aside with Yan Lingyun, silently watching a massacre feast.

There were the powerful men from the Palace of Void and the Wave Sea that had already been broken through, and even the heavenly way on the other side of the starry sky poured out anger into the Chen clan.

The terrifying thunder tribulation kept striking down.

At this moment, the entire Chen clan was like a purgatory on earth.

"Call the ancestors!!!"

Finally, the Chen clan could no longer hold it back.

A terrifying aura suddenly came from the depths of the Chen clan.

However, as Xu Wuzi, the owner of the Palace of Void Palace, slapped it out with a slap, his breath suddenly dissipated.

"Continue to kill!"

The Chen clan was completely desperate.

I don’t know how long it took, the Chen clan was silent and there was no more living.

"Chen Yu, are you satisfied with this result?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng pulled Yan Lingyun and slowly walked to Chen Yu.

Chen Yu slowly raised his head and looked at Yan Lingyun blankly.

At this moment, Yan Lingyun still had that cold face, and her eyes were still a little sad.

Finally, he understood why Yan Lingyun was like this.

Everything is because of the man beside her.

"I, I beg you, kill me."

Chen Yu knelt on the ground with a pleading tone.

He only had one thought left now.

That's death.
